sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Power To Levy Professional Tax In India:

Professional tax is imposed by the state government in India. It is imposed on individuals making money through professions, jobs, trades, etc. Employers need professional tax registration to deduct professional tax from salary of workers and remit it to the concerned state government. The rate of professional tax vary by state. Although, professional tax is mentioned in Article 276 of the Indian Constitution, but the state governments have the authority to make laws relating to it. Many states in India do not impose any kind of professional tax.

Every working individual is liable to pay a part of his/her income to the concerned state government in the form of professional tax. It is generally mentioned in salary slip of individuals. A company can directly deducts this amount as a professional tax from monthly salary of an employee, if it has professional tax registration. In addition to salaried individuals, other professionals directly pay it to the state government. You can also claim a tax deduction for professional tax paid as per the Income Tax Act 1961
We are mentioning a list of essential documents for registration of professional tax
You need to submit both the online and hard copy of the application form.
Certificate of Incorporation (COI), Articles of Association (AOA), and Memorandum of Association (MOA) of Companies. PAN card of the company is also required, and it must be attested by the Director.
Self-attested PAN card is needed for Proprietorship firms to obtain a professional tax registration.
Details of all Directors and employees of the company along with their identity proof and proof of address, and passport-size photos.
Bank account details, Bank statement, and cancelled cheque of the company.
Registered Office proof, if it is rented property, an NOC from the owner is required.

Other details, like Board Resolution of companies, Declaration of consent by all the Partners of a partnership firm, and salary and attendance records. You can consult any top tax consultant in India for this registration.
Read the complete process of registration of professional tax
You must provide PAN card, proof of address and identity of all the directors/partners/proprietors of the company.
Furnish all the details related to employees of the company.
Each employee need to fill the application form for professional tax.

How is professional tax calculated?

Professional Tax in India is calculated on salary slabs. The exact amount of professional tax is decided by the respective state government. The ceiling limit and slabs is vary depending on the state.
How much of my salary is deducted as professional tax?

Professional Tax is deducted by the employer before calculating income tax, and it varies depending on the state. Every state has the exclusive right to fix the rate of professional tax. The amount deducted from the salary of an individual is remitted to the State Government.
Do we need to pay professional tax?
Yes, Professional Tax is mandatory for all, but it depends on the state where you are working, if there is a provision of professional tax, then defaulting will attract penalties.
Why does professional tax differ in every state?
Professional Tax rules vary from state to state, allowing each state to set its own rates and limits. The maximum limit is Rs. 2500 per year, and salary slab structures vary.
Why is professional tax different in every state?
Professional Tax law varies depending on states, and each state is free to determine the rates and the ceilings. The ceiling limit is Rs. 2500 per year, and salary slab structures vary.
Who is subject to tax under the Professional Tax Act?
The employer of any organisation, professionals working in various fields are subject to pay Professional Tax levied by the respective state governments.
